confidence_notes: I used two of the six allowed web searches. The FX search returned an official RBA exchange-rates page and a secondary aggregator that gave the RBA 4pm rate for 18 November 2026 as 0.6720 USD per AUD. I did not open the RBA page itself, so the server should check this figure against the official source. Restaurant meal, beer and cappuccino prices come from aggregated cost-of-living summaries, mainly Numbeo-based figures from June 2026 (inexpensive meal about EUR 17.70, three-course meal for two about EUR 72.88, 0.5 L draught beer about EUR 5.31, cappuccino about EUR 4.0-4.2). I converted these to USD at about 1.10 USD per EUR, which I derived from the same secondary FX search result. I nudged them up slightly for July peak-season pricing. I did not search cocktail or wine prices. Those two are estimates based on the local relationship to beer prices and typical Austrian levels, so they are less certain. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checks of live listings. July is peak season in Salzburg and overlaps the Salzburg Festival, so room rates are set high and could vary widely.
comparable_city_reasoning: Salzburg is a premium tourist city in Austria. Its restaurant prices sit above the national average and roughly match Vienna and Innsbruck, with similar alpine and Western European tourism pricing. Summer festival demand pushes accommodation above Vienna's.
